_comment: A whole config.json for the game with Maester-12B behind the owner's llama-swap (docs/local-ai/OWNER-CHECKLIST.md). Copy it to config.json (git-ignored), or keep it anywhere and start the game with WC_CONFIG=<path>. baseUrl is the owner's llama-swap (8033); change the port if yours differs. ONE model process, two aliases: 'maester-12b' = Gemma 4 12B + the Westeros LoRA (interpret, mind, director, audience, council, consolidate); 'maester-12b:plain' = the same process with the adapter off, for narrate and the call kinds that were not tuned (letter, advisor, counsel, polish, probe). No slot is pinned (llama.cpp #28280). allowModelSwaps is only a guard: the two names are one llama-server, nothing is swapped. Then run: npm run model:check
